market.question: Will the highest temperature in Jeddah be 35°C on May 10?

assessment.reasoning: Jeddah May average high 95°F (35°C); range 90-101°F. May 9 forecast is hotter at ~37.8°C, suggesting the early-mid May warm spell is already in progress. May 10 likely closer to 36-37°C than 35°C. 35°C bucket probability ~15-25%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the warm spell persists or eases by May 10
